data: In fiscal 2023, which ended June 30, 2023, Microsoft reported total revenue of about $211.9 billion ($211,915 million), up roughly 7% from $198.3 billion in fiscal 2022. Gross profit was about $146.1 billion ($146,052 million), a gross margin of roughly 68.9%, slightly below the 68.4% to 68.9% range of the prior year mainly because of lower Windows OEM and devices mix offset by cloud growth. Operating income was about $88.5 billion ($88,523 million), an operating margin of roughly 41.8%, down from about 42.1% in fiscal 2022. The fiscal 2023 figure was weighed down by a $1.2 billion charge in the second quarter tied to severance, hardware portfolio changes and lease consolidation.
